affected_objects.content: An argument was made to distinguish between a cache and a short-term/working memory, positing that a working memory needs to be 'cleaner' than a cache that stores frequently accessed data.

The project's primary challenge has been identified as retrieval from the multi-layer memory system, which is composed of working, short-term, and long-term memory. The key problem is how to weight the retrieval results from these three separate memory types to achieve the best performance in agent response generation.

The primary challenge in the multi-layer memory architecture (working, short-term, and long-term memory) is determining how to weight the separate retrieval results from each of the three memory types to generate the best possible response.
